title: Meta Launches Muse Code AI Agent, Capable of Performing Full Software Engineering Tasks in Large Codebases

content_html:
Meta has officially launched its AI programming agent, Muse Code, designed for large codebase development scenarios, helping programmers complete the entire software engineering process from task planning, code writing to result verification. The tool is currently in the testing phase. Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg stated that Muse Code can perform end-to-end development tasks in complex software projects, further enhancing AI's application capabilities in the engineering field.

According to the introduction, Muse Code is based on Meta's previously released coding model, Muse Spark, and can be installed and used through terminal commands. It adopts a multi-agent collaboration mechanism to handle large projects. When the task size is large, the system automatically splits the task, with multiple sub-agents executing in independent work trees in parallel, avoiding modifications to the user's current code environment. Zuckerberg mentioned that during testing, Muse Code successfully handled six features for a game development project without any code conflicts.

This release marks Meta's further commitment to the AI software development tools sector, aiming to enhance its competitiveness in the AI agent market. Currently, products such as OpenAI's Codex and Anthropic's Claude Code are already competing among developers. Meta hopes to attract more developers by leveraging lower costs and the advantages of a multi-agent architecture.

Alexandr Wang, Meta's head of artificial intelligence and director of the Meta Super Intelligence Lab, said that for a wide range of workflows and application scenarios, Muse Code could become a cost-effective choice. In recent years, Meta has continuously expanded its AI investments, not only using AI to optimize its advertising business but also launching an intelligent agent for customer service and support in June of this year, further positioning itself in the enterprise-level AI market. As AI agents evolve from code assistance tools to independently completing complex tasks, the competition for automation in the software development industry is accelerating.

content_html_zh:
Meta正式推出AI编程代理Muse Code，专为大型代码库开发场景而设计，帮助程序员完成从任务规划、代码编写到结果验证的整个软件工程流程。 该工具目前正处于测试阶段。 Meta首席执行官马克·扎克伯格表示，Muse Code可以在复杂的软件项目中执行端到端的开发任务，进一步增强AI在工程领域的应用能力。

据介绍，Muse Code基于Meta之前发布的编码模型Muse Spark，可以通过终端命令安装和使用。 它采用多代理协作机制来处理大型项目。 当任务规模较大时，系统自动拆分任务，多个子代理在独立的工作树中并行执行，避免修改用户当前的代码环境。 扎克伯格提到，在测试过程中，Muse Code 成功处理了游戏开发项目的六个功能，没有任何代码冲突。

此次发布标志着Meta进一步致力于AI软件开发工具领域，旨在增强其在AI代理市场的竞争力。 目前，OpenAI的Codex和Anthropic的Claude Code等产品已经在开发者之间展开竞争。 Meta 希望通过利用更低的成本和多代理架构的优势来吸引更多的开发者。

Meta人工智能负责人、Meta超级智能实验室主任Alexandr Wang表示，对于广泛的工作流程和应用场景，Muse Code可能成为一种经济高效的选择。 近年来，Meta不断加大人工智能投入，不仅利用人工智能优化广告业务，还于今年6月推出了智能客服和支持代理，进一步定位企业级人工智能市场。 随着人工智能代理从代码辅助工具发展到独立完成复杂任务，软件开发行业的自动化竞争正在加速。
